steps.what: Test sites and materials with appropriate equipment and assess the resulting evidence

tasks.design: Retain physical testing and evidence assessment with the investigator, recording the observations in {DOCS}. Existing instrument functions support measurements without earning a new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reliable evidence depends on appropriate sampling, handling and test execution.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing measurement tools help testing but do not replace hands-on work or interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Damaged materials and uncertain exposure histories complicate what tests can establish.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator recognizes contamination, unsuitable tests and limits on the inference.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in testing responsibility or assumed effort.

reach.task: Preserve traceability between a sample and its observations
reach.learn: Evidence handling and method limitation records

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: physical fire-evidence testing retains human effort; existing instrument runtime is not a labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary covers the investigator's testing and assessment, excluding separate laboratory work and formal report production.

The investigator identifies samples, checks procedure and equipment status, conducts tests and records observations during fully counted s1. Missing provenance or uncertain method suitability requires manual resolution; no structured test-valid flag is presumed.
Use existing instrument records and document forms before custom tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or mandatory record process is introduced.
research_questions: Is any distinct repeated transcription measurable after current instrument exports are used?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine samples and damaged or ambiguous evidence retain physical handling and expert assessment.

steps.what: Dust evidence or fire scene surfaces for latent fingerprints and preserve recovered evidence

tasks.design: Keep physical fingerprint recovery with the qualified investigator and its traceability record in {DOCS}. This design introduces no automated recovery or matching step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recovery depends on surface condition and careful physical technique.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support evidence traceability without replacing recovery work.
tasks.still_hard: Fragile traces can be damaged or contaminated during handling.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator adjusts technique to the actual surface and preserves context.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in recovery responsibility or physical effort.

reach.task: Document recovery provenance for forensic examination

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: dusting and preserving latent fingerprint evidence remain physical work; no saving is established by this design.

assumptions: Boundary is physical recovery and its contemporaneous record, excluding fingerprint identification and separate investigative reports.

The investigator verifies item identity and scene location and captures recovery time, method and evidence reference during counted s1. Missing provenance prompts manual resolution before handoff; no machine step assumes a completed evidence record.
Use native evidence-record forms before custom software.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or additional reporting process is proposed.
research_questions: Is any distinct duplicate record entry measurable without altering recovery technique?

already_counted.description: Physical recovery, preservation and provenance capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Recoverable and damaged surfaces both retain investigator handling; downstream matching is outside this task.

steps.what: Assess public assemblies and determine permit scope and conditions
Populate permit particulars and chosen conditions in the standard document
Check the final permit and issue it under verified authority

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} template fields to populate an inspector-authored permit decision. The inspector retains assessment, verifies the final particulars and conditions, and issues the exact permit through the authorized channel.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying of already determined permit particulars created clerical effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Template fields can reuse explicit particulars without a model or automatic eligibility decision.
tasks.still_hard: Permission, conditions and actual issuing authority depend on local rules and event facts.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector decides whether the evidence supports the proposed assembly and its conditions.
tasks.altitude: A little document preparation time returns to checking event-specific conditions; issuing authority does not change.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Firefighting and Prevention Workers

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native template population can remove repeated copying after human permit decisions; no sourced local permit-saving case is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary covers the inspector's assessment, permit preparation and issue only where that role has authority. If another authority issues the permit, that action is outside the role and the design must be remapped before estimating savings.

The inspector produces s1 fields: application identifier, organizer, verified address, event date, capacity, chosen conditions, validity period, decision and issuing authority. Capture and verification stay counted; applicant material is checked manually. Missing or nonstandard conditions require manual drafting rather than inferred fields.
Test native document or case-system templates before custom generation; existing automatic population earns no new credit.
Seven incremental focal hours cover condition-template review and exception checks; three other-role hours cover field mapping and access.
unknowns: National and local permit requirements and issuing authority
research_questions: Can template population reproduce checked permits without omitting event-specific conditions?

incremental.description: Review condition templates and manual exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact organizer, location, date, capacity, conditions, validity and permit version; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R75 gives25 gross minus7 focal upkeep =18 net. Existing populated forms or frequent bespoke conditions reduce conservative saving to0-4%; assessment and issuing checks retain full time.

steps.what: Plan staff work from case priorities, capacity and required capabilities
Supervise staff, train proper procedures and evaluate observed performance

tasks.design: Keep work planning in {PROJECT} and staff coaching and evaluation with the supervisor. Existing {DOCS} procedures support training without treating attendance or activity logs as proof of competence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe assignments and useful feedback depend on context and observed capability.
tasks.enabler_now: Current planning records supply context without replacing supervisory decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Uneven experience, sensitive feedback and changing case demands require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognizes when staff need support and gives specific, credible feedback.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in supervisory authority or assumed effort.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Firefighting and Prevention Workers
reach.task: Coach staff on evidence-based prevention practice

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: substantive work planning, training and performance evaluation remain human work in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is the inspector's supervision, excluding staff execution, payroll and separately owned scheduling administration.

The supervisor verifies case priorities, availability and capability context in counted s1 and captures observed performance and feedback in s2. Missing information prompts direct clarification; no ready-made performance or competence flag is assumed.
Use existing planning and procedure records before custom monitoring or scheduling tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or performance-monitoring process is proposed.
unknowns: Supervisory span and existing planning tools
research_questions: Is any distinct duplicate planning entry measurable while preserving staff assessment and coaching?
